nodes.label: Browser handover (user signs in on agent's browser)
nodes.rationale: Primary fallback when stealth is not enough: some sites gate on account trust rather than fingerprint and want a human once. Headed Camoufox on the shared profile is bridged out via Xvfb + openbox + x11vnc + websockify to a branded noVNC page (proxied through vestad on a box), and sign-ins persist in the shared profile so the agent's browser grows more trusted over time.
